We’re expanding across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and Peru , and we’re looking for a Senior Clinical Database Programmer to help build the foundation of our clinical data operations in LATAM.

In this high‑impact role, you’ll lead the development, testing, implementation, and support of clinical databases from start-up through post‑lock, while partnering closely with Data Management, Project Management, EDC vendors, and clients.

You’ll guide database design, oversee programming activities, troubleshoot complex technical issues, support system administration, forecast project needs, and contribute to SOP and process development. This is also a unique opportunity to mentor junior programmers, train end users, support onboarding, and influence how our new regional team grows.

If you’re motivated by technical leadership, collaboration, and the chance to help shape a new regional department from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you! Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to: Maintains responsibility of assigned projects.

Ensures on-time delivery, communicates the status of projects to internal teams and study Maintains awareness of the key elements of the contract and scope of work for assigned project(s) and communicates status updates to the Project team as necessary.

Perform project forecasting of hours, and identification of resource requirements and manages project budgets including identification of out-of-scope work and post production changes Provides input and guidance to the design of clinical databases to the client and internal teams Builds and supports clinical databases Develops, tests, and validates programs and clinical database to support client-related projects and third-party applications.

Provides system administration and advanced technical support services for internally developed applications and clinical databases, client-related projects and third-party applications Troubleshoots and resolves software and clinical database problems Develops and maintains study-specific validation documents Provides support to data management for client-related projects from CRF design to post database close and archival May design, develop and validate the Company’s internal applications, client-related projects and third-party applications.

Participate in software vendor selection Participate in conducting EDC demonstrations and trainings Participate in the development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and corresponding process documentation related to data management and database management activities Supports with onboarding of new hires Provide leadership for cross-functional and organization-wide initiatives, where applicable Trains and ensures that all data management project team members have been sufficiently trained Communicate with study sponsors, vendors and project teams as needed regarding data, database or other relevant project issues Present software demonstrations/trainings, department/company training sessions, present at project meetings Performs all duties in accordance with SOPs, government regulations, guidelines and industry standards.

both written and oral Experience in Object Oriented Programming (C#, C++, VBS, etc.…) Understanding of CDISC standards (CDASH, SDTM, ADaM, etc.) Experience in clinical database management system development Experience in a clinical, scientific or healthcare discipline Proficiency in more than one CDMS system to include building forms, edit checks and complex rule development Awareness of CRF standards and input to maintenance of standards library Ability to troubleshoot and support peers with technical issues and build solutions Broad knowledge of drug, device and/or biologic development and effective data management practices Strong leadership and interpersonal skills Preferred: Experience in a clinical, scientific or healthcare discipline and multiple therapeutic area experience, preferably Oncology Experience in utilizing various Database Programming systems Skills: Competencies: Ability to work independently, manage time and create plans to achieve project revenue and business goals Ability to work effectively with minimal direction; s.h: WAS DU BEI UNS VERANTWORTEN KANNST**
s.t:
Als Softwareentwickler gestaltest du aktiv die Entwicklung moderner Softwarelösungen und treibst die technische Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte voran. In einem agilen Team übernimmst du eine Rolle mit dem Anspruch, hochwertige, skalierbare und nachhaltige Lösungen zu schaffen. Dabei übernimmst du folgende Aufgaben:
Du entwickelst neue Funktionen und Anwendungen sowie bestehende Softwarelösungen kontinuierlich weiter.
Du analysierst fachliche und technische Anforderungen und setzt diese gemeinsam mit deinem Team in praxistaugliche Lösungen um.
Du arbeitest mit modernen Entwicklungswerkzeugen, automatisierten Build- und Deployment-Prozessen sowie Cloud-Native-Technologien.
Du unterstützt bei der Bereitstellung und dem Betrieb von Anwendungen und trägst zu einer hohen Qualität und Stabilität unserer Lösungen bei.
Du bringst deine Ideen und Erfahrungen aktiv ins Team ein, lernst kontinuierlich dazu und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Technologien und Arbeitsweisen mit.
Qualifikation

Du bringst eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker:in (m/w/d), ein Studium der Informatik, Informationsmanagements oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung sowie erste einschlägige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit. Zudem verfügst du über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau. Diese Erfahrungen erleichtern dir den Einstieg:
Erfahrung in der Entwicklung moderner Softwarelösungen mit Programmiersprachen wie Go oder Java
Gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitekturen, Design Patterns und der Entwicklung wartbarer, skalierbarer Anwendungen
Erfahrung im Umgang mit Container-Technologien (Docker & Kubernetes) sowie CI/CD-Pipelines; Zertifizierungen wie die Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) oder Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) sind von Vorteil
Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL, MySQL) und modernen Entwicklungspraktiken wie Clean Code und automatisiertem Testing
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden sowie daran, Anforderungen in praxisnahe Softwarelösungen zu übersetzen

Als Softwareentwickler bei Cloudogu arbeitest du an spannenden Kundenprojekten und entwickelst moderne Softwarelösungen mit Technologien rund um Cloud Native, Kubernetes und Open Source.
Du hast die Möglichkeit, dein technisches Know-how kontinuierlich auszubauen, neue Technologien kennenzulernen und aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Produkte und Lösungen mitzuwirken. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit erfahrenen Kolleg zusammen, bringst eigene Ideen ein und übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung in Projekten.
Wenn du Freude daran hast, nachhaltige Software zu entwickeln, gemeinsam mit Kund:innen Herausforderungen zu lösen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln, dann ist Cloudogu dein space to be.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Embedded Software Engineer to lead the development of software for next-generation defense-grade Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) gimbal systems. The successful candidate will architect and develop high-performance, low-latency video processing and streaming software for embedded computing platforms while integrating cameras, sensors, communication interfaces, and embedded hardware into a mission-critical stabilization and targeting system.
This role requires strong expertise in embedded Linux, multimedia frameworks, GPU-accelerated computing, networking, and hardware/software integration. You will collaborate closely with systems, electronics, computer vision, mechanical, and control engineers to deliver robust, production-ready solutions for demanding defense applications.

s.h: What is your Day to Day Mission
s.t:
Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for defense-grade EO/IR gimbal systems.
Develop real-time video capture, processing, encoding, decoding, recording, and streaming applications on embedded Linux platforms using GStreamer, FFmpeg, and hardware-accelerated multimedia frameworks.
Develop reliable networking solutions for real-time video transport using RTP, RTSP, UDP, TCP, H.264, and H.265.
Develop high-performance image processing and computer vision applications using CUDA, OpenCV, or equivalent GPU-accelerated technologies where applicable.
Integrate visible, infrared, and thermal imaging sensors into embedded systems.
Develop software interfaces for IMUs, laser rangefinders, and other mission-critical sensors.
Develop Linux device drivers and perform kernel-level integration for custom hardware.
Interface with embedded hardware using SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, MIPI CSI, HDMI, and other industry-standard interfaces.
Optimize software for deterministic performance, low latency, and efficient utilization of CPU, GPU, and hardware accelerators.
Design scalable communication architectures between embedded processors, payload controllers, flight controllers, and external systems.
Support hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, verification, and field testing.
Implement logging features and analyze issues reported by testing and customers
Produce software architecture documentation, interface specifications, and technical documentation.
Participate in system architecture, design reviews, and technology roadmap planning.

s.h: What you bring to the team
s.t:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Robotics, or a related discipline.
5+ years of professional experience developing embedded software for Linux-based systems.
Strong expertise in Embedded Linux application development.
Experience with Linux kernel development, device drivers, and hardware abstraction layers.
Strong C/C++ and/or Rust programming skills.
Experience with GStreamer and/or FFmpeg multimedia frameworks for low-latency, high-performance multimedia and video streaming applications.
Experience with H.264/H.265 video codecs and streaming technologies including RTSP, RTP, UDP, and TCP.
Experience integrating embedded peripherals using SPI, UART, I²C, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, and similar interfaces.
Experience integrating imaging sensors and peripherals such as IMUs, GPS, encoders, or similar devices.
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and troubleshooting in embedded or distributed systems.
Experience with hardware/software integration and embedded system debugging.
Familiarity with GPU computing, OpenCV, CUDA, or equivalent hardware acceleration technologies.
Experience with Git, CMake, cross-compilation, and embedded Linux development workflows.
Strong systems thinking with an understanding of software architecture and hardware/software interface design.

We are searching for a senior software engineer to join the Creator organization. This team is responsible for the user experiences and systems used to onboard creators and drive their growth across LTK , one of the largest creator-guided shopping and brand marketing platforms in the industry.

The ideal Senior Software Engineer for this space will be organized, productive, and comfortable working across the full stack. You will have strong experience in building scalable, production-quality web applications that anticipate significant growth across multiple dimensions.

You’ll be inventive and have a pragmatic and iterative approach to delivering high quality software. You’ll ruthlessly prioritize accomplishing the highest impact deliverables first, and provide valuable guidance to the engineering manager on the direction of the team’s web architecture and systems.

You will proactively establish lines of communication across the teams and business units, and draw on them to make the team successful. How you will make an impact Coming up with feasible and practical solutions to tough problems. Design, build, and maintain high-quality fullstack systems and experiences.

Take end-to-end ownership of features across the stack: from early technical design and prototyping through implementation, testing, rollout, and ongoing iteration. Collaborate with product, design, and other engineers to deliver intuitive, performant, and accessible fullstack experiences that delight creators and brands.

Optimize fullstack applications and services for performance, scalability, and reliability. Champion best practices in architecture, usability, security, and cross-platform compatibility across the full stack.

Use AI tools to expedite daily workflows (e.g., code generation, refactoring, test creation, documentation) and to improve both speed and quality of web development. Leverage AI-assisted development practices to prototype, iterate on, and maintain web features efficiently, while holding a high bar for safety and code quality.

Write very high-quality, well-tested code that is robust and easy to maintain. Take ownership of projects and drive them to completion. Work and succeed in a fast-paced and agile development environment. Identify and drive improvements to our fullstack architecture, tooling, and development processes.

Conduct constructive peer design/code reviews and provide clear, actionable feedback. Work with distributed teams across different time zones. Serve as a technical subject matter expert for fullstack development who mentors fellow engineers, demonstrates technical experience, and leads teams in solving challenging problems.

What you will bring to LTK 5+ years of software development experience, with significant time spent building and maintaining production-scale fullstack applications. Deep experience with modern fullstack development, including both front-end and back-end technologies.

Demonstrated proficiency in React.js (or another comparable framework), including building complex, component-based single-page applications Strong understanding of front-end architecture and patterns (component design, state management, routing, modularization).

Experience with modern web tooling and ecosystems (e.g., Webpack/Vite, npm/yarn, linting, formatting, testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or similar). History of designing and building highly scalable, resilient web experiences that serve a growing user base.

Experience integrating with backend services and APIs (REST/JSON, HTTP; GraphQL) and working closely with backend teams to define interfaces and contracts. Strong focus on performance, accessibility, security, and usability in web applications.

Demonstrated experience using AI tools as part of the software development lifecycle (coding, debugging, testing, documentation) with concrete examples of improved productivity or quality.

Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated code, refine it, and integrate it safely and effectively into production systems while maintaining team standards and best practices.

Experience designing and building backend services or APIs to support web applications in a modern server side language (Go, Java Experience with AWS systems such as ECS, Lambda, and RDS (among others). Experience working in a containerized environment (preferably Docker).

Experience with databases such as MySQL, DynamoDB Experience with observability tools like Datadog Comfortable shipping code multiple times per day. Strong technical leadership and mentoring skills. Ability to model and conceptualize integrations across complex systems and how services interact across the full stack.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Who are we? At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.
We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.
We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.
Our Product team at UpGuard comprises our Product Management, Product Support, Engineering, Design, Data Leaks Detection, and Third Party Risk Management Services.

Our Product team’s vision is to become the leader in the Cyber VRM category by providing a best-in-class SaaS platform for organisations to manage their third-party risk and external attack surface. Our purpose as a Product team is simply to build a product that enables this.

We aim to build a product that users love and come to rely on, and one that regularly and consistently improves.
About The Role We’re hiring engineers at multiple levels to join our Product Engineering team as we continue to scale rapidly and sustain strong growth. As Software Engineers at UpGuard, we immerse ourselves in the swiftly evolving and increasingly vital realm of cybersecurity.

Our focus is on presenting data in intelligent and creative ways, crafting integrated solutions that directly influence the security posture of our global customers. With the majority of the internet scanned across multiple vectors daily, we confront challenges like high throughput, massive concurrency, and big data.

The way we address these challenges reflects the essence of the engineers we welcome into our team. In this role, you’ll work within a cross-functional team that values iteration, collaboration, and speed. Together, we deliver customer value quickly while ensuring security and reliability at every step.

We value clean code, thoughtful design, and engineers who care about the product as much as the technology it is built on.

Collaborate with a cross-functional team of engineers, product managers, and designers to create world-class products.

4+ years of relevant engineering experience at tech-centric and product-driven companies

Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.
Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.
Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

You'll work across our entire stack: Java backend services and the TypeScript/Angular frontend that power Soda Cloud. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll own features end-to-end, talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship from database to UI without waiting for hand-offs. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side.

Build features end-to-end: backend APIs, database changes, frontend UI, and ship them to production yourself.
Design and implement backend services for a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
Work with relational databases (MySQL): schema design, query optimization, data modeling.
Build frontend features that are clean, fast, and don't get in the way.
Optimize performance across the stack and write tests at every layer (unit, integration, e2e).
Build agentic features into the product: LLM-powered workflows that help users find, understand, and fix data issues.
Improve our systems for agentic development: agent instructions, skills, and the test feedback loops that make agents effective across the codebase.
Work directly with product, design, and customers to decide what to build. Your opinion matters here.

CV screen
20-minute phone screen
First technical interview (45 min)
Second technical interview (60 min)
Culture fit (45 min)
We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

You Should Have
5+ years building software at a product company : you've owned meaningful parts of a real production system.
Strong Java : REST APIs, database interactions, async processing.
TypeScript and a modern frontend framework : Angular preferred (it's what powers Soda Cloud).
Frontend fundamentals : complex UIs, component architecture, state management, performance, responsive design.
Solid SQL in a backend context : schema design, query optimization, migrations in production. We run MySQL and ClickHouse.
Testing as a habit : you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright).
Architectural judgment : you design APIs from the consumer's perspective and understand how those choices shape data flow and latency across the stack.
DevOps fluency : containers, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, comfortable on Linux.
Agentic engineering : you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high.
Independence : you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
Fluent English.
Good to Have

An eye for design: you can spot a misaligned pixel.
Python: our data engineering stack runs on it.
Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users.
Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience.

Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.

A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries.

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with . Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.
You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.
Why This Role Exists
We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.
The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.

You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.
High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.
Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.
Your Toolbox
We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.
What We Expect at This Level
6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.
Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.
Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.
Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.
Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one.

s.h: Not Suitable for the Role If…
s.t:
You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.
You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.
You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.
You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.

s.h: Sneak Peek: So läuft der Bewerbungsprozess bei Arvana ab

1. Erster kurzer Austausch
Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns direkt am nächsten Tag bei dir zurück. Im ersten Schritt vereinbaren wir mit dir ein 10-minütiges Telefongespräch mit jemanden aus unserem Team. Hier schauen wir, ob es von beiden Seiten aus passt und finden dann direkt schon einen Folgetermin für den Kick-Off Call.
2. Kick-Off Call
Im zweiten Gespräch nehmen wir uns ca. 30 - 45min. Zeit. Wir möchten dich richtig kennenlernen, wissen, was dich fasziniert und dich antreibt. Gleichzeitig bieten wir dir auch einen tieferen Blick hinter die Kulissen von Arvana und beantworten dir alle deine Fragen. Nach dem Gespräch kannst du mal alles reflektieren, sodass wir uns am nächsten Tag nochmal kurz austauschen können.
3. Team Meeting
Im letzten Gespräch möchten wir dich gerne in unser Office am Rosenthaler Platz einladen. Du lernst die Gründer Arne und Mirco persönlich kennen und hast auch die Möglichkeit mit dem Team zu quatschen. In ca. 90 Minuten nehmen wir dich tief mit in unsere Prozesse, Mission, den Business-Plan und geben dir einen 360 Grad Einblick. Nach dem Gespräch melden wir uns innerhalb von 2 Tagen bei dir zurück. Wenn alles passt, freuen wir uns, dich im Team zu begrüßen!

We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization. Our customers map reality, with its levers and constraints, into a model, and we run large-scale combinatorial optimization over the critical decisions in their value chain. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.
Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.
Most optimization software fails in the same place. Not in the solver, but in the gap between what a company actually does and what the model assumes. Somebody has to sit with the people who plan today, understand how they really decide, and turn that into something a machine can compute.
That is this role, and you do it hands on. You take the customer's planning problem apart, you build the model yourself, in code, on their data, and you stay with it until their management trusts the result enough to act on it. Then you bring back the part that should stop being project work and become product.
Most of this happens at your desk in Cologne, with days at the customer's site when the decisive conversations happen. You are the shortest path between our product and reality. What does not survive at a customer does not work.
We will not sugarcoat it: the data arrives messy, the first model is rarely the right one, and some weeks a customer deadline sets the priority.
What you'll own
The customer's decision problem. Sit with the people who plan today, understand capacities, costs, lead times and the constraints nobody wrote down, and turn it into a model whose answer a plant manager acts on. Inventory, scheduling, supply shortages, order prioritization: the decisions that determine whether a plant stays competitive.
The customer's model, end to end. You own it from the first conversation to the version that runs in production. Our math and OR team owns the engine and the solver core underneath; you own what is built on top of it for this customer.
The data it runs on. ERP and Excel exports, inconsistent and incomplete. You get them into shape yourself and notice when numbers cannot be right before the customer does.
The result, all the way to trust. Not a demo. A model that is used, questioned, corrected and used again.
The feedback loop into the product. You see the same problem at the second and third customer before anyone else does. You make the call at the customer, and you argue the case for what belongs in the platform.
Your work, from the first line of code to a model the customer runs. Nobody hands you a ticket and waits.
How we work
Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your work end to end: you build it, you ship it to production yourself, you run it.
Feedback runs both ways and continuously, in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals, communicate proactively, and flag early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job.
We review each other's work, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room.

You have built quantitative models for real operations problems and taken them into production, not into a slide deck. Optimization, simulation, or a combination of both.
You have done this more than once, end to end, and at least one of those models still runs without you in the room.
You still write the production code yourself, today.
Before you build anything, you can name the few assumptions and constraints that will decide the result, and you clear them with the customer first. Customers know their goal, they rarely know which constraint binds.
You are comfortable in front of a plant manager or a controller, and you can leave that room knowing what the model has to do. You explain what the model does to people who will never read the code, and to people who will.
You work with messy industrial data as a matter of course. Cleaning it is part of the problem, not beneath the job.
Python at production quality.
You have worked inside a team with shared standards, not only on your own projects.
German and English, both at a level where you can run a customer meeting and write a specification. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English.

Deine Meinung ist unser Produkt.
Code schreiben kann inzwischen jeder. Zu entscheiden, was gebaut wird und was nicht, ist die knappe Ressource geworden. Dafür bezahlt uns der Kunde, und dafür bezahlen wir dich. Wir wollen, dass du in dem ganzen KI-Slop da draußen eine Stimme der Klarheit wirst, an der sich ein Kundenteam ausrichten kann.
Der Preis steht gleich mit dabei: Gute Arbeit allein reicht hier nicht. Eine Entscheidung, die du nicht erklären kannst, wird nicht umgesetzt, egal wie richtig sie ist. Wir helfen dir, darin besser zu werden. Abnehmen können wir es dir nicht.
Wir sind schulz codes: sechs Leute, remote-first, zuhause in Darmstadt. Wir gehen in die Entwicklungsteams von Konzernen und Produktfirmen, damit sie danach schneller und verlässlicher liefern. Nicht als ein Entwickler mehr im Projekt, sondern als die Leute, die den Output vom ganzen Team hochziehen. Das geht nur, wenn wir richtig gut sind, deshalb suchen wir auch nicht schnell, sondern genau.
Ja, das ist Agenturgeschäft. Aber nicht das, was du dir darunter vorstellst. Du springst nicht zwischen fünf Projekten, sondern gehst fest in ein Kundenteam und bleibst da. Du lernst die Domäne richtig, kennst die Leute beim Namen und siehst, was deine Entscheidungen ein Jahr später machen. Es gibt Phasen, in denen ein zweiter Kontext dazukommt, gerade bei einem Projektwechsel. Aber das ist die Ausnahme und wir sagen es dir vorher.
Die Rolle in einem Satz: Du gehst mit uns in ein Kundenteam, baust dort mit und bist der Mensch, an dem die technischen Fragen hängenbleiben.
Drei Dinge bekommst du hier, und die meinen wir wörtlich.
Ownership. Du entscheidest selbst über Architektur, sprichst selbst mit den Fachbereichen und stehst dann auch für das gerade, was du entschieden hast. Niemand entscheidet über deinem Kopf und lässt dich das dann umsetzen. Allein bist du damit trotzdem nicht: Wir gehen mindestens zu zweit in ein Projekt. Einen einzelnen Entwickler irgendwo hinstellen und stundenweise abrechnen ist genau das Geschäft, das wir nicht machen wollen.
Wirksamkeit. Du wirst nicht daran gemessen, wie viele Tickets du zumachst, sondern daran, was das Team um dich herum ein halbes Jahr später kann. Und du siehst das auch, dafür sind wir klein genug.
Und wenn dir was nicht passt, sagst du es und änderst es. Bei uns genauso wie beim Kunden. Das ist hier kein Mut, sondern der Job.
Das ist eine Senior-Rolle in der Lieferung. Du führst kein Team und wir hängen dir auch keinen Lead-Titel als Karotte vor die Nase. Was du bekommst, ist echte technische Verantwortung, direkter Kundenkontakt und Zeit, richtig gut zu werden. Wir versprechen dir hier weniger als andere Anzeigen, dafür halten wir, was drinsteht.
Wo wir hinwollen, ehrlich gesagt: Individualsoftware und Agenturarbeit werden in ein paar Jahren anders aussehen als heute. KI verschiebt gerade, wofür ein Kunde überhaupt bezahlt. Das ist uns bewusst, und wir sitzen es nicht aus. Wir probieren gerade verschiedene Ideen und Modelle aus, in denen Spaß, Lernen und Rentabilität zusammenkommen. Über Köpfe und Stunden zu wachsen gehört ausdrücklich nicht dazu. Was wir konkret testen, erzählen wir dir gern im ersten Gespräch.
Aufgaben
Ganze Features und Epics verantworten, von der Konzeption bis ins Deployment
Dich schnell in fremden Codebasen zurechtfinden und das Gesamtsystem über Backend, Frontend, Infrastruktur und Schnittstellen hinweg sehen
Selbst mit den Fachbereichen sprechen, über Architektur entscheiden und dafür geradestehen
Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Integrationsthemen früh auf den Tisch legen, nicht erst kurz vor dem Release, und kleine Proof-of-Concepts bauen, wenn eine technische Frage anders nicht zu klären ist
So schätzen, dass die Unsicherheit mit drinsteht: nicht „fünf Tage", sondern „fünf Tage, Risiko: die API-Spezifikation ist noch unklar"
Das Team mitziehen: Pairing, Reviews mit Lerneffekt, Onboarding, Standards und Konventionen, die auch nach dir noch halten
Der letzte Punkt ist bei uns kein Extra, sondern der Kern der Sache. Wir sind beim Kunden, um das ganze Team schneller zu machen, nicht um Tickets abzuarbeiten.
Qualifikation
Das bringst du mit
Rund sechs bis acht Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mehrere Jahre Backend in einer typisierten Sprache in Produktion
Architektur selbst verantwortet, nicht nur umgesetzt: Domain-Driven Design, hexagonale Architektur, modularer Monolith sind Entscheidungen, die du getroffen und dann auch ausgehalten hast
Entscheidungen auch dann treffen, wenn die Anforderungen noch wackeln
Saubere Modellierung von Fachdomänen
Cloud auf Architektur-Ebene, mit bewusster Auswahl der Dienste (AWS, Azure und GCP sind uns gleichwertig)
React zuverlässig liefern, ohne Frontend-Spezialist zu sein
Tests schreiben, Reviews vorleben
Ab Woche eins produktiv in einer fremden Codebase
Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, weil du direkt mit deutschen Fachbereichen sprichst und Domänen modelierst
Was dich deutlich nach vorne bringt
Schnittstellen- und Integrations-Design
Gelebte Kommunikation mit Kunden
Schrittweises Modernisieren großer Bestands-Landschaften
„API als Produkt" und Developer Experience
Aktives Auseinandersetzen mit den aktuellen Entwicklung rund um KI und Automatisierungen
Was du ausdrücklich nicht brauchst
Zertifizierungen
Node im Lebenslauf. Kommst du aus Spring oder .NET und bringst React mit, planen wir die Einarbeitung in unseren Stack ein. Was wir dir nicht beibringen können, ist die Architektur-Substanz — die muss da sein
Ein bestimmtes Node-Framework, ob NestJS, Express oder Fastify: die Substanz zählt
Einen Hochschulabschluss. Wir werten Können, nicht Papier
Was uns mehr interessiert als dein Stack
Fachlich passende Leute gibt es viele, die Rolle entscheidet sich am Menschen. Zwei Dinge müssen bei dir da sein.
Lernen als innere Notwendigkeit. Nicht „hab ich gelernt, weil das Projekt es gebraucht hat", sondern der echte Drang zu verstehen und vorne mitzugestalten. KI ist dafür gerade das beste Beispiel: sie soll dich verstärken, damit du weiter kommst und mehr baust, aber dein eigenes Verstehen nie ersetzen.
Der Antrieb, das Arbeiten für alle besser zu machen. Nicht nur den eigenen Fortschritt, sondern Team und Kunde spürbar weiterbringen. Menschen um dich herum heben, echte Verbindung aufbauen. Daraus entsteht Vertrauen, und Vertrauen ist bei uns die Grundlage von allem. Dazu gehört, Verantwortung für deine Arbeit zu übernehmen und ein Stück darüber hinaus.
Und weil das zum Claim oben gehört: Deine Meinung zu vertreten heißt nicht, dich zu inszenieren. Die Frage ist immer, was der Kunde und was das Team braucht - da ordnest du dich ein. Kritik auf Augenhöhe gehört trotzdem dazu, in beide Richtungen. Wer widerspricht, um recht zu haben, ist hier falsch. Wer nie widerspricht, allerdings auch.
Dazu unser härtestes Kriterium: du musst bereit sein, dich auf unsere Arbeitsweise einzulassen. Wir sind sehr offen für deine Ideen und ändern gerne Dinge, aber „so kenne ich das, kommt damit klar" funktioniert hier nicht.
Wann wir nicht zusammenpassen
Wenn dich vor allem Gehalt und Titel treiben

unser Cloud-Marketplace zum Buchen und Verwalten von Abonnements

IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN ’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
Platform Engineering builds what the rest of IREN builds on. We own data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, and product engineering, the systems that turn a fleet of data centers and GPU clusters into a platform our customers and our own teams can move quickly on. Much of it is being built now, for the first time, so there is no legacy stack to maintain and no established playbook to follow.
We are hiring senior software engineers across Platform Engineering. This is an individual contributor role. Seniority here is measured by the scope of what you own and by how much better the engineers around you get, not by how many people report to you. At this level you own the design of whole systems, including the parts that cross team boundaries and the parts you will not build yourself.
The part of the role we weight most heavily is what you do for the engineers around you. We expect you to raise the standard of the people you work with, through design review and code review that teach rather than correct, through pairing, and through handing hard problems to engineers who are ready to stretch. We look for evidence of this during the interview, and we continue to assess it after you join.
Because Platform Engineering builds for other teams, the boundaries matter as much as the internals. You will own the interfaces between your systems and everyone else's, negotiate what those contracts guarantee, and manage versioning and compatibility when something has to change.

That work is as much communication as design, so we expect you to write clearly and to be comfortable in a room where people disagree. We also expect depth: senior engineers here are the person the company asks about a particular domain, whether that is data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering.

Engineers at every level at IREN stay hands on, senior ones included. Responsibilities
Own system design from end to end: the problem statement, architecture, interfaces, data model, and rollout, including the parts other engineers will build.
Coach and develop the engineers around you. Give review that teaches, pair on hard problems, and hand over work that stretches people rather than keeping it because you would finish it faster.
Own the API contracts between your systems and other teams: negotiate what they guarantee, version them, and manage the migration when they change.
Set technical direction for your area, and write it down so other teams can build against it without needing a meeting first.
Break large, ambiguous problems into work that a team can sequence, estimate, and deliver.
Lead delivery across team boundaries, including the coordination and follow up that this actually requires.
Stay hands on. Write and review code, and carry the pager for what you own.
Own operations for your systems: monitoring, on-call, incident response, and the follow up that stops the same incident recurring.
Be the person the company can ask about your domain, and make what you know available to others rather than holding it.
Raise the standard through the systems around the code: CI/CD, observability, testing practice, and documentation.

6 or more years of professional software engineering experience, including several years operating in production what you built.
A record of owning system level design rather than components alone. You have been the person accountable for how a whole system fits together.
Deep experience with distributed systems, including failure modes you have personally debugged rather than only read about.
Demonstrated coaching. Be ready to name engineers who grew because of how you worked with them, and to say what actually changed.
Experience owning APIs that other teams depend on, including versioning and breaking change migrations.
Excellent communication, particularly in writing. You can write a design document another team can act on without a meeting.
Depth in at least one domain relevant to this team: data engineering, automation, developer tooling, AI enablement, or product engineering.
Experience leading delivery across more than one team, without formal authority over the people involved.
Strong fundamentals, and the judgement to recognize when the simple answer is the right one.

Our 10,000+ colleagues of more than 105 nationalities are united by a shared independent spirit and commitment to excellence, striving to continuously enrich our Maison-s heritage by pushing the boundaries of creativity and innovation.

As a Software Engineer, you-ll be responsible for the end-to-end development of software solutions that connect our AI and Data Engineering capabilities with tangible business value. You-ll design scalable backend infrastructure, create functional user interfaces, and ensure secure, compliant application delivery across the organization.

HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?-The software engineer sits at the vital link between data capabilities and business value, ensuring that every machine learning model and data insight is operationalized into a robust, scalable, and usable application.- Navigating between technical infrastructure and business needs, you will have the opportunity to design the tools and applications that drive business efficiency across the Maison.

YOUR MAIN MISSIONSWithin the Cartier Data Office, you will build business-ready applications, high-performance microservices, and functional internal tools. End-to-End Application Delivery: You will design and develop complete software solutions, handling both server-side logic (Python, FastAPI) and client-side interfaces (HTML, CSS, JS).

API & Microservices Architecture: You will build and maintain microservices and REST APIs to expose data and ML capabilities, ensuring seamless integration within the wider ecosystem.

Organizational Collaboration: You will bridge the gap between tech and business, collaborating effectively with Data Scientists and Data Engineers to operationalize machine learning models and data pipelines into production workflows.

Platform Operations & DevOps: You will maintain robust deployment pipelines (CI/CD, Git) and infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform ensuring reliability and long-term maintainability.

Compliance & Governance: You will ensure all software adheres to group standards, security protocols, and evolving AI regulations, proactively adapting to changing governance models.

Operational Excellence: You will drive engineering efficiency by creating standardized project templates and reusable libraries to significantly accelerate Time-To-Market.

HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?You have a Master-s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related scientific field and 3-5 years of experience in full-stack or backend development.

You have strong proficiency in Python and backend frameworks (e.g., FastAPI), along with knowledge of standard frontend web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript). You have a deep understanding of Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, GKE) and modern deployment workflows (CI/CD, Containerization).

You possess the ability to operate effectively within large, matrixed organizations, managing diverse stakeholders and legacy systems. You are agile and able to align with rapidly evolving internal standards, procedures, and regulatory frameworks (e.g., AI governance).

You can act as a translator, streamlining the connection between the tech and the business to ensure seamless integration of our solutions within the wider ecosystem. HOW DO WE KEEP YOU SMILING?In a young and dynamic team focused on personal development, you will take part in Cartier-s tech journey, leveraging state-of-the-art tools.

You will work with multicultural stakeholders from different business units for a leading Company in the luxury industry. You will have the opportunity to mentor team members as our engineering maturity grows. YOUR JOURNEY WITH USIntroductory Call: If selected, we will reach out ASAP for an informal introductory call.

Technical Interview: A deep dive into your Python, System Design, and software engineering skills with our Team Lead.
